```{r function to create confusion matrix, include=FALSE}
}
```

```{r function to estimate necessary number of PCs, include=FALSE}
npcs <- function(
    seu,
    var.toal=0.95,
    reduction="pca"
){
  if(is.null(seu@reductions[[reduction]])){
    cat("Reduction", reduction, "not found!")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  tmp.var <- (seu@reductions[[reduction]]@stdev)^2
  var.cut <- var.toal*sum(tmp.var)
  n.pcs=0
  var.sum = 0
  while(var.sum < var.cut){
    n.pcs = n.pcs + 1
    var.sum <- var.sum + tmp.var[n.pcs]
  }
  
  return(n.pcs)
}
```

```{r function to process srt after subset, include=FALSE}
seuPreProcess <- function(srt, assay='RNA', n.pcs=100){
  # NormalizeData(srt) |> FindVariableFeatures() |> ScaleData() |> RunPCA()
  pca.name = paste0('pca_', assay)
  pca.key = paste0(pca.name,'_')
  umap.name = paste0('umap_', assay)
  tsne.name = paste0('tsne_', assay)

  srt = Seurat::NormalizeData(
    srt
  ) |> Seurat::FindVariableFeatures(
    assay = assay,
    selection.method = "vst",
    nfeatures = 3000,
    verbose = F
  ) |> Seurat::ScaleData(
    assay = assay
  ) |> Seurat::RunPCA(
    assay = assay,
    reduction.name = pca.name,
    reduction.key = pca.key,
    verbose = F,
    npcs = n.pcs
  )
  
  #find pcs to use (custom function, see helper functions script for details)
  n.pcs.use = npcs(srt, reduction = pca.name, var.toal = 0.9)
  
  # FindNeighbors |> RunUMAP, FindClusters
  srt <- Seurat::FindNeighbors(
    srt,
    reduction = pca.name,
    dims = 1:n.pcs.use,
    force.recalc = TRUE,
    verbose = FALSE
  ) |> Seurat::RunUMAP(
    reduction = pca.name,
    dims = 1:n.pcs.use,
    n.components = 3,
    reduction.name=umap.name
  ) |> Seurat::RunTSNE(
    reduction = pca.name,
    dims = 1:n.pcs.use,
    dim.embed = 3,
    reduction.name=tsne.name
  )
  
  srt@reductions[[umap.name]]@misc$n.pcs.used <- n.pcs.use
  srt@reductions[[tsne.name]]@misc$n.pcs.used <- n.pcs.use
    
  for (r in (res <- seq(0.1, 2, 0.1)))
    srt <- Seurat::FindClusters(srt, resolution = r, random.seed = params$seed, verbose = FALSE)
  
  return(srt)
}
```

```{r twiner-weights}
# Computes per-feature DisTwiner angular-dissimilarity weights across all
# pairwise group combinations.
#
# Arguments:
#   group_cor    – list of per-group correlation matrices (data frames)
#   n_feats      – number of features
#   transform_fn – function applied element-wise to each raw cosine value
#   aggregate_fn – function used to collapse the pair-wise vector per feature
#                  (e.g. min, mean, max)
#
# Returns a numeric vector of length n_feats.
compute_twiner_weights <- function(group_cor, n_feats,
                                   transform_fn, aggregate_fn) {
  group_combs <- combn(length(group_cor), 2)
  n_pairs     <- ncol(group_combs)
  weight_mat  <- matrix(0, nrow = n_pairs, ncol = n_feats)

  for (i in seq_len(n_feats)) {
    for (k in seq_len(n_pairs)) {
      raw <- lsa::cosine(
        group_cor[[ group_combs[1, k] ]][, i],
        group_cor[[ group_combs[2, k] ]][, i]
      )
      weight_mat[k, i] <- transform_fn(raw)
    }
  }
  weight_vec <- apply(weight_mat, 2, aggregate_fn)
  weight_vec[is.na(weight_vec)] <- 0
  return(weight_vec)
}
```

```{r helper-evaluate-model, include=FALSE}
# Evaluates a fitted binary classifier on the held-out test set.
# Saves confusion matrix, precision, recall, F1, and ROC to disk.
#
# `ypred`  – predicted class labels (integer 0/1)
# `yprob`  – predicted probability for class 1 (for ROC)
# `ytest`  – true labels (integer 0/1)
evaluate_model <- function(model_name, ypred, yprob, ytest, BASE_DIR) {
  stopifnot(all(ypred %in% c(0, 1)), all(ytest %in% c(0, 1)))

  # Confusion matrix
  cm <- caret::confusionMatrix(table(ypred, ytest))
  pdf_cm <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "performance", "confusionMatrix",
                      paste0(model_name, ".pdf"))
  pdf(pdf_cm)
    draw_confusion_matrix(cm)
  dev.off()
  saveRDS(cm, sub("\\.pdf$", ".rds", pdf_cm))

  # Scalar metrics
  metrics <- list(
    precision = Metrics::precision(ytest, ypred),
    recall    = Metrics::recall(ytest, ypred),
    f1Score   = Metrics::f1(ytest, ypred),
    rocAUC    = pROC::roc(ytest, yprob, quiet = TRUE)
  )
  for (nm in names(metrics)) {
    saveRDS(
      metrics[[nm]],
      file.path(BASE_DIR, "performance", nm, paste0(model_name, ".rds"))
    )
  }
  invisible(metrics)
}
```

```{r helper-get-selected-features, include=FALSE}
# Extracts the names of non-zero-coefficient features at the lambda that
# minimises cross-validated error for a fitted cv.glmnet object.
get_selected_features <- function(cv_fit, feature_names) {
  best_col   <- which(cv_fit$cvm == min(cv_fit$cvm))
  nonzero_ix <- which(cv_fit$glmnet.fit$beta[, best_col] != 0)
  feature_names[nonzero_ix]
}
```

```{r helper-stability-metrics, include=FALSE}
# Returns the mean pairwise Jaccard index over a list of feature-selection sets.
# Also returns the per-feature selection frequency across folds.
#
# `feat_list` – list of character vectors (one per fold)
# `all_feats` – character vector of all possible feature names
pairwise_jaccard <- function(feat_list) {
  K      <- length(feat_list)
  pairs  <- combn(K, 2)
  scores <- numeric(ncol(pairs))
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(pairs))) {
    a <- feat_list[[ pairs[1, j] ]]
    b <- feat_list[[ pairs[2, j] ]]
    union_n <- length(union(a, b))
    scores[j] <- if (union_n == 0) 0 else length(intersect(a, b)) / union_n
  }
  scores
}

selection_frequency <- function(feat_list, all_feats) {
  freq <- table(factor(unlist(feat_list), levels = all_feats))
  sort(as.numeric(freq) / length(feat_list), decreasing = TRUE) |>
    setNames(names(sort(freq, decreasing = TRUE)))
}
```

```{r helper-variability-metrics, include=FALSE}
# Computes gene-level variability metrics across macrophage cluster means.
#
# For each gene: extract its per-cluster mean log-normalised expression from
# the Seurat object, then compute:
#   cv    = sd(cluster_means) / mean(cluster_means)   [scale-invariant]
#   fano  = var(cluster_means) / mean(cluster_means)  [natural overdispersion]
#
# Both are computed on the per-cluster means, so they measure how much a
# gene's average expression varies across the macrophage subtypes, not cell-
# level noise within clusters.
#
# Returns a data frame with one row per gene.
compute_cluster_variability <- function(srt, genes, cluster_col = "cell_label",
                                        assay = "RNA") {
  expr_mat <- as.matrix(
    Seurat::GetAssayData(srt[genes, ], assay = assay, slot = "data")
  )  # genes × cells
  clusters <- srt[[cluster_col, drop = TRUE]]

  # Per-cluster means: genes × clusters
  cluster_means <- sapply(unique(clusters), function(cl) {
    rowMeans(expr_mat[, clusters == cl, drop = FALSE])
  })

  # Metrics on the row (gene) vectors
  gene_mean <- rowMeans(cluster_means)
  gene_var  <- apply(cluster_means, 1, var)
  gene_sd   <- apply(cluster_means, 1, sd)

  # Guard against division by zero for genes with near-zero mean
  cv   <- ifelse(gene_mean > 1e-6, gene_sd  / gene_mean, NA_real_)
  fano <- ifelse(gene_mean > 1e-6, gene_var / gene_mean, NA_real_)

  data.frame(
    gene      = genes,
    mean_expr = gene_mean,
    cv        = cv,
    fano      = fano,
    row.names = NULL
  )
}
```

```{r helper-cluster-lfc, include=FALSE}
# Computes per-cluster LFC (Old − Young) for each gene, then summarises
# across clusters as mean and SD of LFC.
#
# The per-cluster LFC is: mean(log-norm expr, Old cells in cluster k)
#                         - mean(log-norm expr, Young cells in cluster k)
#
# Mean LFC across clusters answers: does this gene go up/down in aging
# overall (consistent with genome-wide DE)?
#
# SD of LFC across clusters answers: does the aging effect vary by
# macrophage subtype? High SD = cluster-heterogeneous aging response,
# which is precisely what DisTwiner's penalty is designed to capture
# (genes whose co-expression neighbourhood diverges across at least one
# cluster pair).
#
# Clusters where one condition is absent are silently dropped for that
# gene, so n_clusters_used may be < total number of clusters.
#
# Returns a data frame with one row per gene.
compute_cluster_lfc <- function(srt, genes,
                                 cluster_col   = "cell_label",
                                 condition_col = "Condition",
                                 old_label     = "Old",
                                 young_label   = "Young",
                                 assay         = "RNA") {
  expr_mat <- as.matrix(
    Seurat::GetAssayData(srt[genes, ], assay = assay, slot = "data")
  )  # genes × cells

  clusters   <- srt[[cluster_col,   drop = TRUE]]
  conditions <- srt[[condition_col, drop = TRUE]]

  cl_levels <- unique(clusters)

  # Per-cluster LFC matrix: genes × clusters (NA where a condition is absent)
  lfc_mat <- sapply(cl_levels, function(cl) {
    old_idx   <- clusters == cl & conditions == old_label
    young_idx <- clusters == cl & conditions == young_label

    if (sum(old_idx) == 0 || sum(young_idx) == 0) {
      return(rep(NA_real_, length(genes)))
    }
    rowMeans(expr_mat[, old_idx,   drop = FALSE]) -
    rowMeans(expr_mat[, young_idx, drop = FALSE])
  })
  # sapply returns genes × clusters when genes > 1; guard single-gene edge case
  if (is.null(dim(lfc_mat))) lfc_mat <- matrix(lfc_mat, nrow = 1)
  rownames(lfc_mat) <- genes
  colnames(lfc_mat) <- cl_levels

  data.frame(
    gene             = genes,
    mean_lfc         = rowMeans(lfc_mat,          na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_lfc           = apply(lfc_mat, 1, sd,      na.rm = TRUE),
    var_lfc          = apply(lfc_mat, 1, var,      na.rm = TRUE),
    n_clusters_used  = apply(lfc_mat, 1, function(x) sum(!is.na(x))),
    row.names        = NULL
  )
}
```

```{r helper-compute-de-lfc, include=FALSE}
# Computes per-gene log2 fold-change (Old − Young) on a given set of cells.
# This is the ranking statistic used for the DE+LR baseline. Running this
# on training cells only inside each fold prevents data leakage.
#
# Returns a named numeric vector sorted descending by |LFC|.
compute_lfc <- function(xdata_subset, ydata_subset) {
  old_idx   <- ydata_subset == 1
  young_idx <- ydata_subset == 0
  if (sum(old_idx) == 0 || sum(young_idx) == 0) {
    stop("Training fold has cells from only one condition.")
  }
  lfc <- colMeans(xdata_subset[old_idx,   , drop = FALSE]) -
         colMeans(xdata_subset[young_idx, , drop = FALSE])
  sort(lfc, decreasing = TRUE)
}
```

```{r helper-mi, include=FALSE}
# Discretises a continuous vector into Q equal-frequency (quantile) bins.
# Zero-inflated scRNA-seq expression is handled naturally: zeros accumulate
# in the lowest bin(s), which is informative rather than artefactual.
discretize_quantile <- function(x, Q = params$mi_bins) {
  breaks <- unique(quantile(x, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = Q + 1),
                            na.rm = TRUE))
  if (length(breaks) < 3) return(rep(1L, length(x)))  # effectively constant
  as.integer(cut(x, breaks = breaks, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE))
}

# Plug-in mutual information estimator I(X; Y) in bits (log2).
# Positive bias for small samples, but consistent; acceptable here because we
# are comparing methods on the same data, so relative differences are valid.
compute_mi_plugin <- function(x_disc, y_labels) {
  n          <- length(x_disc)
  joint      <- table(x_disc, y_labels) / n
  px         <- rowSums(joint)
  py         <- colSums(joint)
  outer_prod <- outer(px, py)
  mi_terms   <- ifelse(joint > 0, joint * log2(joint / outer_prod), 0)
  sum(mi_terms)
}

# Compute MI(gene expression; label) for a matrix of genes (rows = genes,
# cols = cells).
compute_gene_mi <- function(expr_mat, labels, Q = params$mi_bins) {
  apply(expr_mat, 1, function(x) {
    x_disc <- discretize_quantile(x, Q = Q)
    compute_mi_plugin(x_disc, labels)
  })
}
```

```{r load data}
mac_labels <- c("lateMacs", "repMacs", "intMacs",
                "regMacs 1", "regMacs 2", "infMacs")

srt <- readRDS(file.path(params$project_dir, "processed_data", "Seurat", paste0(params$dataset, ".rds"))) |>
  subset(subset = cell_label %in% mac_labels)

# Extract log-normalised expression matrix (cells × genes)
xdata <- t(as.matrix(Seurat::GetAssayData(srt, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")))

# Remove genes with zero variance across all cells
xdata <- xdata[, apply(xdata, 2, sd) != 0]

# Binary condition label: Young = 0, Old = 1
ydata  <- as.integer(unname(srt$Condition) == "Old")
ylabel <- as.character(unname(srt$cell_label))
data   <- data.frame(xdata, y = ydata, label = ylabel)

# 90 / 10 train-test split (fixed for all models)
itrain <- sort(sample(nrow(xdata), floor(nrow(xdata) * 0.9)))
itest  <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(xdata)), itrain)
```

```{r build correlation matrices}
groups     <- unique(data[["label"]])
group_list <- lapply(groups, function(g) {
  data[data[["label"]] == g, !colnames(data) %in% c("y", "label")]
})

# Drop zero-variance genes within each group
group_list <- lapply(group_list, function(mat) {
  mat[, apply(mat, 2, sd) != 0, drop = FALSE]
})

# Retain only genes present in all groups and in the full xdata
col_common <- Reduce(intersect, c(list(colnames(xdata)), lapply(group_list, colnames)))
group_list <- lapply(group_list, function(x) x[, col_common, drop = FALSE])
xdata      <- scale(xdata[, col_common])

# Scale within each group before computing correlations
group_list <- lapply(group_list, scale)

group_cor <- lapply(group_list, function(x) {
  propagate::bigcor(x, y = NULL, fun = "cor", size = 2000, verbose = FALSE)
}) |>
  lapply(function(x) as.data.frame(ff::as.ffdf(x))) |>
  lapply(function(x) mutate(x, across(everything(), \(v) replace_na(v, 0))))

n_feats <- ncol(xdata)
```

```{r distwiner-model}
model <- "distwiner"

# --- Weight computation ---
linear_dissim <- function(raw) 1 - acos(raw)/pi

ang_weight <- compute_twiner_weights(
  group_cor    = group_cor,
  n_feats      = n_feats,
  transform_fn = function(r) exp(linear_dissim(r)),
  aggregate_fn = function(x) {
    pos <- x[x > 0]
    if (length(pos) == 0) 0 else min(pos)
  }
)

# Weight distribution
p_weights <- ggplot(data.frame(weight = ang_weight), aes(x = weight)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01, fill = "#69b3a2", color = "#e9ecef", alpha = 0.9) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  xlab("Feature weight") + ylab("Count")

ggsave(file.path(params$base_dir, "featureWeight", paste0(model, ".pdf")),
       p_weights, width = 9)

# Free large intermediate objects before model fitting
rm(group_cor, group_list)
gc()

# --- Fit penalised elastic net ---
fit_distwiner <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(
  xdata[itrain, ], as.factor(ydata[itrain]),
  family         = "binomial",
  nfolds         = 10,
  alpha          = 0.9,
  penalty.factor = ang_weight,
  type.measure   = "mse"
)
saveRDS(fit_distwiner,
        file.path(params$base_dir, "trainedModels", paste0(model, ".rds")))

# --- Predictions ---
ypred_class <- as.integer(
  predict(fit_distwiner, newx = xdata[itest, ], type = "class")
)
yprob_pos <- predict(
  fit_distwiner, newx = xdata[itest, ], type = "response"
)[, 1]

evaluate_model(model, ypred_class, yprob_pos, ydata[itest], params$base_dir)

# --- Selected features ---
var_selected_distwiner <- get_selected_features(fit_distwiner, colnames(xdata))
saveRDS(var_selected_distwiner,
        file.path(params$base_dir, "selectedFeatures", paste0(model, ".rds")))
```

```{r random-forest-model}
model <- "randomForest"

xtrain <- xdata[itrain, ]
xtest  <- xdata[itest, ]
ytrain <- as.factor(ydata[itrain])
ytest  <- as.factor(ydata[itest])

rf <- randomForest::randomForest(
  x = xtrain, y = ytrain,
  xtest = xtest, ytest = ytest
)

ypred_class <- as.integer(as.character(rf$test$predicted))
yprob_pos   <- rf$test$votes[, 2]

evaluate_model(model, ypred_class, yprob_pos, ydata[itest], params$base_dir)
```

```{r svm-model}
model <- "svm"

feat_col <- which(!colnames(data) %in% c("y", "label"))
dataset  <- data.frame(xdata, ydata = factor(ydata, levels = c(0, 1)))
y_col    <- which(colnames(dataset) == "ydata")

# Note: xdata is already scaled — no additional scaling applied here
training_set <- dataset[itrain, ]
test_set     <- dataset[itest, ]

classifier <- e1071::svm(
  formula     = ydata ~ .,
  data        = training_set,
  type        = "C-classification",
  kernel      = "linear",
  probability = TRUE          # required for predict(..., probability = TRUE)
)
saveRDS(classifier,
        file.path(params$base_dir, "trainedModels", paste0(model, ".rds")))

ypred_raw   <- predict(classifier, newdata = test_set[, -y_col],
                       probability = TRUE)
ypred_class <- as.integer(as.character(ypred_raw))
yprob_pos   <- attr(ypred_raw, "probabilities")[, "1"]

evaluate_model(model, ypred_class, yprob_pos, ydata[itest], params$base_dir)
```

```{r feature-comparison}
# Load from disk so this chunk is self-contained when re-run independently
fit_distwiner <- readRDS(file.path(params$base_dir, "trainedModels", "distwiner.rds"))
fit_en        <- readRDS(file.path(params$base_dir, "trainedModels", "elasticNet.rds"))

sel_dt <- get_selected_features(fit_distwiner, colnames(xdata))
sel_en <- get_selected_features(fit_en,        colnames(xdata))

df_scatter <- data.frame(
  weight = ang_weight,
  idx    = seq_along(ang_weight),
  class  = dplyr::case_when(
    colnames(xdata) %in% sel_dt & colnames(xdata) %in% sel_en ~ "Both",
    colnames(xdata) %in% sel_dt                                ~ "DisTwiner only",
    colnames(xdata) %in% sel_en                                ~ "Elastic Net only",
    TRUE                                                        ~ "Neither"
  )
)

CLASS_COLOURS <- c(
  "Both"             = "purple",
  "DisTwiner only"   = "red",
  "Elastic Net only" = "blue",
  "Neither"          = "grey80"
)

# Scatter: weight by feature index, coloured by selection class
p_scatter <- ggplot(df_scatter, aes(x = idx, y = weight, colour = class)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = filter(df_scatter, class != "Neither"),
             size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = CLASS_COLOURS) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Feature index", y = "DisTwiner weight", colour = NULL)

ggsave(file.path(params$base_dir, "selectedFeatures", "disTwinerVSelasticNet.pdf"),
       p_scatter)
print(p_scatter)

# Density histogram of weights, stratified by selection class
p_hist <- ggplot(df_scatter,
                 aes(x = weight, fill = class, y = after_stat(density))) +
  geom_histogram(colour = "#e9ecef", alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = CLASS_COLOURS) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "DisTwiner weight", y = "Density", fill = NULL)
```

```{r feature-stability-analysis}
K <- params$n_stability_folds

sel_distwiner_folds <- vector("list", K)
sel_en_folds        <- vector("list", K)

for (fold in seq_len(K)) {
  set.seed(params$seed + fold)   # different split each fold, reproducible
  idx_train <- sort(sample(nrow(xdata), floor(nrow(xdata) * 0.9)))

  # --- DisTwiner (penalised elastic net, weights fixed from full itrain) ---
  fit_dt_fold <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(
    xdata[idx_train, ], as.factor(ydata[idx_train]),
    family         = "binomial",
    nfolds         = 5,           # inner CV; 5 keeps runtime manageable
    alpha          = 0.9,
    penalty.factor = ang_weight,
    type.measure   = "mse"
  )
  sel_distwiner_folds[[fold]] <- get_selected_features(fit_dt_fold, colnames(xdata))

  # --- Elastic Net (no penalisation) ---
  fit_en_fold <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(
    xdata[idx_train, ], as.factor(ydata[idx_train]),
    family       = "binomial",
    nfolds       = 5,
    alpha        = 0.9,
    type.measure = "mse"
  )
  sel_en_folds[[fold]] <- get_selected_features(fit_en_fold, colnames(xdata))

  cat(sprintf(
    "Fold %2d/%d | DisTwiner: %d features | Elastic Net: %d features\n",
    fold, K,
    length(sel_distwiner_folds[[fold]]),
    length(sel_en_folds[[fold]])
  ))
}

saveRDS(sel_distwiner_folds,
        file.path(params$base_dir, "stability", "distwiner_fold_features.rds"))
saveRDS(sel_en_folds,
        file.path(params$base_dir, "stability", "elasticNet_fold_features.rds"))
```

```{r stability-jaccard}
jacc_dt <- pairwise_jaccard(sel_distwiner_folds)

df_jaccard <- data.frame(
  jaccard = c(jacc_dt, jacc_en),

  mean(jacc_dt), sd(jacc_dt), mean(jacc_en), sd(jacc_en)
))

# Wilcoxon test: is DisTwiner's Jaccard distribution shifted higher?

cat(sprintf("Wilcoxon test (DisTwiner > Elastic Net): W = %.0f, p = %.4f\n",
            wt$statistic, wt$p.value))

p_jaccard <- ggplot(df_jaccard, aes(x = model, y = jaccard, fill = model)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +

        axis.title = element_text(size = 14)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Pairwise Jaccard index",
    title = sprintf(
      "Feature selection stability across %d re-sampling folds\np = %.4f (Wilcoxon, DisTwiner > Elastic Net)",
      K, wt$p.value
    )
  )

ggsave(file.path(params$base_dir, "stability", "pairwise_jaccard_violin.pdf"),
```

```{r stability-overlap-heatmap}
# Visualise per-fold selection as a binary heatmap for the union of
# consistently selected features (selected in ≥50% of folds by either model).
top_union <- union(top_dt, top_en)

make_fold_matrix <- function(feat_list, features) {
  mat <- matrix(0L, nrow = length(feat_list), ncol = length(features),
                dimnames = list(paste0("Fold ", seq_along(feat_list)), features))
  for (f in seq_along(feat_list)) {
    mat[f, intersect(feat_list[[f]], features)] <- 1L
  }
  mat
}

mat_dt <- make_fold_matrix(sel_distwiner_folds, top_union)
mat_en <- make_fold_matrix(sel_en_folds,        top_union)

# Sort features by DisTwiner selection frequency for a cleaner visual
feat_order <- names(sort(colSums(mat_dt), decreasing = TRUE))

df_heatmap <- rbind(
  reshape2::melt(mat_dt[, feat_order],
                 varnames = c("Fold", "Feature"), value.name = "Selected") |>
    mutate(Model = "DisTwiner"),
  reshape2::melt(mat_en[, feat_order],
                 varnames = c("Fold", "Feature"), value.name = "Selected") |>
    mutate(Model = "Elastic Net")
)

p_heatmap <- ggplot(df_heatmap,
                    aes(x = Feature, y = Fold, fill = factor(Selected))) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "grey93", "1" = "#2c7bb6"),
                    labels  = c("Not selected", "Selected")) +
  facet_wrap(~ Model, ncol = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 9),
    strip.text   = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Per-fold selection of consistently selected features")

ggsave(file.path(params$base_dir, "stability", "selection_heatmap.pdf"),
       p_heatmap, width = max(10, length(top_union) * 0.4), height = 8, limitsize = FALSE)
print(p_heatmap)
```

```{r variability-compute}
# Union of all genes evaluated (selected by any method + a random background)
# Background: 2000 randomly sampled unselected genes for context
set.seed(params$seed)
all_selected   <- union(sel_dt, sel_en)
background     <- sample(
  setdiff(colnames(xdata), all_selected), size = 2000
)
genes_to_eval  <- union(all_selected, background)
genes_to_eval  <- intersect(genes_to_eval, rownames(srt))  # safety check

cat(sprintf(
  "Evaluating variability for %d genes (%d DisTwiner, %d EN, %d background)\n",
  length(genes_to_eval),
  length(intersect(genes_to_eval, sel_dt)),
  length(intersect(genes_to_eval, sel_en)),
  length(intersect(genes_to_eval, background))
))

# Compute variability on log-normalised (unscaled) expression
var_df <- compute_cluster_variability(srt, genes_to_eval, cluster_col = "cell_label")

# Annotate by selection class (a gene can belong to multiple classes)
var_df <- var_df |>
  mutate(
    in_disTwiner = gene %in% sel_dt,
    in_en        = gene %in% sel_en,
    selection    = case_when(
      in_disTwiner & in_en  ~ "Both",
      in_disTwiner          ~ "DisTwiner only",
      in_en                 ~ "Elastic Net only",
      TRUE                  ~ "Background"
    )
  )

saveRDS(var_df, file.path(params$base_dir, "variability", "cluster_variability.rds"))
```

```{r variability-cluster-lfc-plot}
    title = "Mean per-cluster aging LFC by feature selection class"
  )

# ── SD of LFC across clusters ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# High SD = aging effect is cluster-heterogeneous. DisTwiner selects genes
# where co-expression structure diverges across at least one cluster pair,
# so we expect DisTwiner-only genes to show higher SD than EN-only or
# background genes.
p_sd_lfc <- ggplot(lfc_df, aes(x = selection, y = sd_lfc, fill = selection)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7) +

        axis.title = element_text(size = 13)) +
  labs(
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "SD of per-cluster LFC (Old − Young)",
    title = "Cluster-heterogeneity of aging LFC by feature selection class"
  )

# ── Scatter: mean LFC vs SD LFC ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Quadrant interpretation:
#   top-right:    large consistent aging response AND heterogeneous across clusters
#   top-left:     heterogeneous but no overall direction
#   bottom-right: consistent direction, uniform across clusters
#   bottom-left:  no meaningful aging signal
p_scatter_lfc <- ggplot(
  lfc_df,
  aes(x = abs(mean_lfc), y = sd_lfc, colour = selection, alpha = selection)
) +
  geom_point(size = 0.9) +
```

```{r variability-stats}
# Pairwise Wilcoxon tests between selection classes for each metric.
# Comparisons of interest: DisTwiner only vs EN only, and each vs Background.
comparison_pairs <- list(
  c("DisTwiner only", "Elastic Net only"),
  c("DisTwiner only", "Background"),
  c("Elastic Net only", "Background")
)

run_wilcoxon_pairs <- function(df, metric_col) {
  purrr::map_dfr(comparison_pairs, function(pair) {
    x <- df[[metric_col]][df$selection == pair[1]]
    y <- df[[metric_col]][df$selection == pair[2]]
    x <- x[is.finite(x)]
    y <- y[is.finite(y)]
    wt <- wilcox.test(x, y, alternative = "two.sided", exact = FALSE)
    data.frame(
      metric    = metric_col,
      group1    = pair[1],
      group2    = pair[2],
      n1        = length(x),
      n2        = length(y),
      median1   = median(x),
      median2   = median(y),
      W         = wt$statistic,
      p_value   = wt$p.value,
      p_adj_BH  = NA_real_   # filled after all tests collected
    )
  })
}

wilcox_results <- bind_rows(
  run_wilcoxon_pairs(var_df, "cv"),
  run_wilcoxon_pairs(var_df, "fano")
)
wilcox_results$p_adj_BH <- p.adjust(wilcox_results$p_value, method = "BH")

print(wilcox_results)
saveRDS(wilcox_results,
        file.path(params$base_dir, "variability", "wilcoxon_results.rds"))
```

```{r variability-cluster-lfc-stats}
# Pairwise Wilcoxon tests for mean_lfc and sd_lfc, appended to the existing
# wilcox_results table from the CV/Fano analysis so everything is in one place.
wilcox_lfc <- bind_rows(
  run_wilcoxon_pairs(lfc_df, "mean_lfc"),
  run_wilcoxon_pairs(lfc_df, "sd_lfc")
)

# BH correction jointly across all variability tests (CV, Fano, mean_lfc, sd_lfc)
wilcox_variability_all <- bind_rows(wilcox_results, wilcox_lfc)
wilcox_variability_all$p_adj_BH <- p.adjust(
  wilcox_variability_all$p_value, method = "BH"
)
wilcox_variability_all$significant <- wilcox_variability_all$p_adj_BH < params$padj_threshold

print(wilcox_variability_all)
saveRDS(wilcox_variability_all,
        file.path(params$base_dir, "variability", "wilcoxon_all_variability_metrics.rds"))
```

# Entropy analysis

```{r entropy-compute}
# Genes to evaluate: union of DisTwiner and EN selected sets + background
genes_mi   <- intersect(genes_to_eval, colnames(xdata))
expr_genes <- t(as.matrix(
  Seurat::GetAssayData(srt[genes_mi, ], assay = "RNA", slot = "data")
))  # cells × genes

cluster_labels   <- as.character(srt$cell_label)
condition_labels <- as.character(srt$Condition)

cat(sprintf("Computing MI for %d genes...\n", length(genes_mi)))

# These are the most expensive calls in this document.
# Each applies discretise + plug-in estimator per gene.
mi_cluster   <- compute_gene_mi(t(expr_genes), cluster_labels,
                                Q = params$mi_bins)
mi_condition <- compute_gene_mi(t(expr_genes), condition_labels,
                                Q = params$mi_bins)

mi_df <- data.frame(
  gene         = genes_mi,
  mi_cluster   = mi_cluster,
  mi_condition = mi_condition,
  row.names    = NULL
) |>
  mutate(
    in_disTwiner = gene %in% sel_dt,
    in_en        = gene %in% sel_en,
    selection    = case_when(
      in_disTwiner & in_en  ~ "Both",
      in_disTwiner          ~ "DisTwiner only",
      in_en                 ~ "Elastic Net only",
      TRUE                  ~ "Background"
    )
  )

saveRDS(mi_df, file.path(params$base_dir, "entropy", "mutual_information.rds"))
cat("Done.\n")
```
